name: Compressible Fluid Flow and Gas Dynamics
description: Governing equations, 1D inviscid compressible flows, shocks and expansion waves, method of characteristics, compressible laminar boundary layers and jets, shock-boundary layer interaction, vibrational non-equilibrium, chemically reacting compressible flows, instability in compressible flows, compressible turbulent flows, Favre-averaged Navier-Stokes (FANS), closure models, Applications to turbomachinery, special topics (kinetic theory/rarefied flows/ionization effects/combustion/CFD/propulsion)
